// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/FinalizationRegistry/proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2019 Leo Balter. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var newTarget = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
function fn() {}
var finalizationRegistry;

newTarget.prototype = undefined;
finalizationRegistry = Reflect.construct(FinalizationRegistry, [fn], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(finalizationRegistry), other.FinalizationRegistry.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is undefined');

newTarget.prototype = null;
finalizationRegistry = Reflect.construct(FinalizationRegistry, [fn], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(finalizationRegistry), other.FinalizationRegistry.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is null');

newTarget.prototype = true;
finalizationRegistry = Reflect.construct(FinalizationRegistry, [fn], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(finalizationRegistry), other.FinalizationRegistry.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Boolean');

newTarget.prototype = '';
finalizationRegistry = Reflect.construct(FinalizationRegistry, [fn], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(finalizationRegistry), other.FinalizationRegistry.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a String');

newTarget.prototype = Symbol();
finalizationRegistry = Reflect.construct(FinalizationRegistry, [fn], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(finalizationRegistry), other.FinalizationRegistry.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Symbol');

newTarget.prototype = 1;
finalizationRegistry = Reflect.construct(FinalizationRegistry, [fn], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(finalizationRegistry), other.FinalizationRegistry.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Number');
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/WeakMap/proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var o = Reflect.construct(WeakMap, [], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.WeakMap.prototype);
})();

newTarget.prototype = undefined;
wr = Reflect.construct(WeakRef, [{}], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(wr), other.WeakRef.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is undefined');

newTarget.prototype = null;
wr = Reflect.construct(WeakRef, [{}], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(wr), other.WeakRef.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is null');

newTarget.prototype = true;
wr = Reflect.construct(WeakRef, [{}], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(wr), other.WeakRef.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Boolean');

newTarget.prototype = '';
wr = Reflect.construct(WeakRef, [{}], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(wr), other.WeakRef.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a String');

newTarget.prototype = Symbol();
wr = Reflect.construct(WeakRef, [{}], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(wr), other.WeakRef.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Symbol');

newTarget.prototype = 1;
wr = Reflect.construct(WeakRef, [{}], newTarget);
